text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufufun♪
Did you see that? That's the great Teio-sama for ya!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, wasn't I amazing?
Wasn't I strong? Wasn't I totally cool?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on!
Don't you have something to say to me?
choice_data_list: You're capable of far more than this, aren't you?
You have much more to give than this, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on!
Don't you have something to say to me?
choice_data_list: You're capable of far more than this, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's just not enough~.
It's totally fine to praise me more, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~n♪
Yours truly is in a fantastic mood today!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna win next time too,
so have looooots of compliments ready for me, okay?♪"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course♪
Who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "I decided the moment I started running that I'm gonna keep on winning from here on out!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Even more than you're expecting, Trainer! Waaay more!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll show you what victory looks like!
